How much is a used Nike Dunk Low worth?

Nike Dunk Lows range from common colourways that sell near shop price to limited releases worth much more. The style code tells you which.

Updated 2026-11-06 · by FlipLens

Which one do you have?

The style code (for example DD1391-100) is on the size label inside the shoe and on the box. It identifies the exact colourway. Search the code, not just the name.

What decides the price

  • Colourway: limited releases far above general releases.
  • Size: common men's sizes sell fastest.
  • Condition: creasing, sole wear and yellowing.
  • Box and authenticity: the original box and a matching code.

Check before you buy

  • Match the style code on the shoe and the box.
  • Check the stitching, the swoosh and the insole for fakes.
  • Look at the soles and the heel for wear.

Where it sells best

Sells on Vinted and eBay; limited pairs on authenticated resale platforms. Put the style code in the listing.

Today's price

Prices for a used Nike Dunk Low change every week, so this page gives no fixed numbers. FlipLens reads current eBay listings for the exact model and condition, removes bundles, broken items and other models, and shows a quick-sale, expected and high price, your profit after fees and the most to pay. Questions

How much is a used Nike Dunk Low worth?

It depends on colourway, size, condition and authenticity. Are Nike Dunk Lows still worth reselling?

Limited colourways yes. Common ones such as general releases often sell close to or below shop price.

Where is the style code on Nike shoes?

On the size label inside the tongue or on the side wall, and on the box label.
